# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 31 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam's Final Words to His Children

---

**1** Adam called Seth: 'My son, I am dying. Listen to my final words and hold them dear.'

**2** 'After I die, don't mourn more than six days. The seventh day is the sign of the resurrection — a day of rest from all toil.'

**3** Adam blessed Seth and said: 'May the Lord God bless you and your descendants for all generations.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
